x-e-h1-09.title: Beeksisa wal-faallessan lama gaazexaa mana barumsaa keessatti akkamitti barreessina?
x-e-h1-09.goal: Dubbistootaaf (barattootaaf) beeksisa wal-fakkaataa hin ta'in lama haqa qabeessaan dabarsu, wanta hin mirkanoofne fi dubbistoonni maal gochuu akka qaban barreessi.
x-e-h1-09.material:
Garee gulaaltummaa gaazexaa Afaan Ingiliizii mana barumsaa keessa jirta. Beeksisoonni lamaan waa'ee ayyaanaa walii wal-hin-simne.

Beeksisa mana barumsaa: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Poostara koree barattootaa: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Isa kam sirrii akka ta'e ammayyuu hin mirkaneessine.
x-e-h1-09.thinking.0: Odeeffannoo hin mirkanoofne haqa qabeessaan dabarsuu
x-e-h1-09.prereq.0: Beeksisa Afaan Ingiliizii gabaabaa sadarkaa kutaa jalqabaa mana barumsaa sadarkaa ol-aanaa dubbisuu
x-e-h1-09.prereq.1: Muuxannoo guyyaa guyyaa beeksisonni waa'ee taatee wal-fakkaataa garaagara ta'uu danda'u
x-e-h1-09.s.s1.prompt: Beeksisa kam gaazexaa keessatti kaa'uun haqa qabeessa dha?
x-e-h1-09.s.s1.hint.0: Beeksisni tokkoon tokkoon isaa dubbistootaaf odeeffannoo maal akka kennu fi maal akka dhokfatu wal bira qabi.
x-e-h1-09.s.s1.hint.1: Hima soba ta'uu danda'u mirkaneessu argadhu.
x-e-h1-09.s.s1.r.a: Odeeffannoo hin mirkanoofne tokko qofa filatamee mirkaneeffame.
x-e-h1-09.s.s1.r.b: Dubbistoota akka hin dhufne ajaja hin barbaachisne kenna, beeksisa lamaan tokkoon tokkoon isaa maal akka jedhe hin himu.
x-e-h1-09.s.s1.explain: Yoo hin mirkanoofne ta'e, haqa qabeessummaan madda lamaan tokkoon tokkoon isaa maal akka jedhu dubbachuu fi dubbistootaaf ammayyuu mirkaneeffamaa jiraachuu himuu dha. Gama tokko filatanii mirkaneessuu ykn odeeffannoo malee akka hin dhufne jechuun dubbistoota dogoggorsa.
x-e-h1-09.s.s2.prompt: Beeksisa hima Afaan Ingiliizii 2-3 dubbistootaaf kan barattoota kutaa 9 ta'an barreessi. Haala: yeroo lamaan madda lamaanii (4 fi 5) lamaanuu barreessi, madda moggaasi (beeksisa, poostara), ammayyuu hin mirkanoofne jedhi, akkasumas dubbistoonni maal gochuu akka qaban himi.
x-e-h1-09.s.s2.hint.0: Duraan qabiyyee beeksisa lamaanii tartiiba 'madda + yeroo + gatii' jedhuun qopheessi.
x-e-h1-09.s.s2.hint.1: Hima dhumaa keessatti wanta dubbistoonni gochuu qaban tokko (eegi, gaafadhu) galchi.
x-e-h1-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Erga dubbisee booda, dubbistoonni yeroon kam sirrii akka ta'e dogoggoruu danda'aa?
x-e-h1-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wanta madda tokkoon tokkoon isaa jedhe sirriitti wal-simsiifteettaa?
x-e-h1-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Dhimmi murtaa'uu dhabuu fi tarkaanfii dubbistootaa ifa dhaa?
x-e-h1-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Dubbistoonni kallattiin akka mirkaneessan karaa kenne.
x-e-h1-09.s.s2.modelNote.2: "Being checked" fi "please wait" gaaffii waliin fayyadame.

x-e-h1-01.title: Dhimma tokkoon 'yeroo hundaa' jechuun ni danda'amaa?
x-e-h1-01.goal: Barreeffama falmii keessatti, sarara ragaan dubbicha gahaa hin deeggarre argi, himicha caalaatti of eeggannoo qabuun deebisii barreessi, akkasumas ragaan dabalataa maal barbaachisu murteessi.
x-e-h1-01.material:
Kun kutaa barreeffama gaazexaa mana barumsaa keessatti maxxanfame dha (lakkoofsonni sararaa 1 irraa jalqabu).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone.
x-e-h1-01.thinking.0: Garaagarummaa ragaa fi xumura gidduu jiru argachuu
x-e-h1-01.thinking.2: Dubbii ragaa wajjin akka simatuuf deebisii barreessuu
x-e-h1-01.prereq.0: Barreeffama falmii gabaabaa Ingliffaa sadarkaa kutaa 1ffaa mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa dubbisuu
x-e-h1-01.prereq.1: Hubannoo guyyaa-guyyaa 'sababa' fi 'tasaan waliin ta'uu' garaagara ta'uu danda'a
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.prompt: Barreeffama kana keessatti, sararoota ragaa sarara 2ffaa keessa jiru caalaa xumura guddaa fidan keessaa inni jalqabaa kami?
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sarara hundaaf, 'wanta gabaase' fi 'wanta xumure' addaan baasi.
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sarara hundaaf, sarara sun nama tokko, nama muraasa, ykn nama hundumaa dubbata gama isaa barreessii ragaa sararoota duraa keessa jiru wajjin wal bira qabi.
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.explain: Sararri 3ffaa rakkoo dha. Gadi bu'iinsa qabxii barataa tokkoo qofa (sarara 2ffaa) irratti hundaa'uun barattoota hundaaf qabxiin "mirkanaa'ee" hamaa ta'a jechuun xumura ragaa caalaa guddaa dha. Gadi bu'iinsi qabxii sababa kan biraa, akka ulfaatina qormaataa ykn haala qaamaa, qabaachuu danda'a. Sararri 4ffaa sababa gosa garaagara qabxii irraa (sagalee, hanna) kenna, kanaaf rakkoo kana irraa addaatti ilaalamuu qaba. "Hundaaf dhorkamu" sarara 5ffaa illee xumura kana irratti hundaa'a, garuu bakki rakkoon jalqabaa uumamu sarara 3ffaa dha.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.prompt: Daataan haaraan kam dubbii sarara 3ffaa sirrii moo hin taane qoruuf baayyee mijaa'aa dha?
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Daataan filannoo hundaa yoo walitti qabame, sarara 3ffaa dogoggora yoo ta'e iyyuu daataan wal fakkaataan ba'uu danda'uu moo hin danda'in yaadi.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dhimma wal fakkaataa muraasa dabaluun sababoota kan biraa dhabamsiisuu moo hin dhabamsiisne yaadi.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.a: Yaadni namootaa jijjiirama qabxii dhugaa irraa garaagara ta'uu danda'a.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.c: Kun dhimma gosa wal fakkaataa caalaa walitti qaba. Sababoota kan biraa barattoota sanaa qabxii isaanii gadi bu'e hin ukkaamsu.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.d: Akkamitti bilbilli kutaa keessatti fayyadamama qabxii wajjin walitti dhufeenya kallattiidhaan hin agarsiisu.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.explain: Barattoota bilbila qaban fi hin qabne yeroo wal fakkaataa keessatti yoo wal bira qabde, ibsi 'bilbila irraa kan ka'e' sababoota kan biraa caalaa gaarii ta'uu madaaluu dandeessa. Dhimma caalaa walitti qabuu ykn yaada gaafachuun dubbicha jabaa akka dhaga'amu godha qofa.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.prompt: Sarara 3ffaa ragaa sarara 2ffaa wajjin akka simatuuf deebisii barreessi (Ingliffaan himoota 1-2), akkasumas dubbicha mirkaneessuuf daataan dabalataa maal akka barbaachisu barreessi.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.hint.1: 'Hin mirkaneessu' fi 'daataa barbaachisu' lamaanuu dabaluu yaali.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Himni ati barreessite odeeffannoo sarara 2ffaa (barataa tokko) caalaa hin himuu?
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Daataa ati eerte wajjin, 'dhimma bilbila hin qabne' wajjin wal bira qabuu dandeessaa?
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Himni sun sababoonni kan biraa jiraachuu danda'u agarsiisaa?

Ibsa beeksisa dhugaatii: "Brain Boost juice improves memory."
Ibsa kanaaf ragaan afur jira.

x-e-h1-06.prereq.1: Hubannoo guyyaa guyyaa 'garee wal bira qabuu' ibsuuf gahaa
x-e-h1-06.s.s1.prompt: Ragaan kam ibsa 'Brain Boost improves memory' gaariitti deeggara?

x-e-h1-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ragaa garee lamaan akkamitti akka qoodaman jedhu barbaadi.
x-e-h1-06.s.s1.r.a: Quufinsi wanta yaadannoon fooyya'eera irraa adda.
x-e-h1-06.s.s1.r.c: Seenaan beekamaa nama tokkoo dha, wal bira qabuu hin qabu.

x-e-h1-06.s.s2.hint.1: Amalli sun qabxii ol guddisuu danda'aa moo hin danda'u yaadi, hima keessatti walitti hidhi.
x-e-h1-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Sababni kan biraa ati barreessite dhugumaan bitattoota fi kanneen hin bitne garaagara taasisuu danda'a?
x-e-h1-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: 'Hin mirkaneessu' fi 'soba dha' garaagara ta'uu isaa ni mul'ataa?
x-e-h1-06.s.s2.modelNote.1: Sababni kan biraa duraan barataan bitu moo hin bitne murteessuu danda'a jedhee ibse.

x-e-h1-04.s.s1.reflect: Kallattiin yeroo dabalu hundaa hiikni kee jijjiirameeraa? Yoo jijjiirame, himicha jijjiirama fide tokko eeri.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.prompt: Sababni baayyee barbaachisaa 'Great.' akka aariitti dubbifamu godhe maali, hiika gaarii osoo hin taane?
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sababni hundi dhugumatti haasaa keessatti barreeffame moo hin barreeffamne mirkaneessi.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.hint.1: Haala daqiiqaa 40 booda hin jiru jedhii 'Great.' irra deebitii dubbisi.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.o.a: Jechoonni gaarii waan ta'aniif, garuu dhufuu booda isaa wajjin hin simatan.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.r.b: Kun waliigala jecha tokko yeroo hundaa hiika wal fakkaataa qaba jedhu dha.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.o.c: Sababni isaa sagaleen Mina guddaa ture.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.r.c: Haasaan kun sagalee ishee ilaalchisee odeeffannoo hin qabu. Sababa kallattii kennamee keessa hin jirre uumame dha.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.explain: Hiikni jechoota qofaan osoo hin taane jechoonni haala wajjin simatan moo hin simanne irraa murtaa'a. Jechoonni gaarii yoo ta'anii haalli hamaa yoo ta'e, hiika dhokate shakkuu dandeessa.

x-e-h1-05.title: 'I have a test' didaa dhaa moo hin dhiisne?
x-e-h1-05.goal: Hiika deebiin kallattiidhaan hin himne (didaa moo hin taane) murteessuuf odeeffannoo dabalataa maal akka barbaachisu qindeessi, akkasumas wal hin hubannoo osoo hin uumin gaafatu ergaa barreessi.
x-e-h1-05.material:
Kun ergaa barreeffamaa Jin fi Hana gidduu jiru.

Jin: Are you coming to the study group tonight?
Hana: I have a huge test tomorrow.
Jin: So is that a no?
Hana: Haha, I don't know yet.
x-e-h1-05.thinking.0: Hiikni dhokate tokko qofa ta'ee akka hin murtoofne argamsiisuu
x-e-h1-05.thinking.1: Odeeffannoo murtee barbaachisu odeeffannoo hin barbaachisne irraa adda baasuu
x-e-h1-05.prereq.0: Ergaa barreeffamaa Afaan Ingiliizii gabaabaa sadarkaa kutaa jalqabaa mana barumsaa sadarkaa ol-aanaa dubbisuu
x-e-h1-05.prereq.1: Muuxannoo guyyaa guyyaa deebiin gaaffii kallattiin hin deebisne ta'uu danda'u
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.prompt: Hana dhufuu moo hin dhufu murteessuuf wanta dabalataan beekuu qabdu hunda filadhu.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Haala deebiin Hana 'deemuu hin danda'u' jedhu tokko fi 'nan deema' jedhu tokko yaadi.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Filannoo keessatti odeeffannoo haalota lamaan adda baasu barbaadi.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.r.b: Yeroon qormaataa dhufuu Hana waliin kallattiin wal-qabatiinsa hin qabu.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.r.d: Baay'inni namootaa filannoo Hana murteessuu keessatti kallattiin hin fayyadamu.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.explain: Jecha Hana 'qormaata irraa kan ka'e deemuu hin danda'u' ykn 'qormaataaf qo'achuuf nan deema' jechuu danda'a. Kanaaf garichi qormaata wal-fakkaataaf ta'uu isaa, akkasumas Hana yeroo qo'atu nama akkamii akka ta'e beekuu qabda.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.0: Kaayyoon garee murtee murteessuuf odeeffannoo baay'ee barbaachisaa dha. Amala qo'annoo Hana ilaaluun illee caalaa gaarii dha.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.1: Amalli qo'annoo barbaachisaa dha, garuu garichi qormaata wal-fakkaataaf ta'uu isaa illee ilaaluu qabda.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.prompt: Akka Jin, Hana'f ergaa Afaan Ingiliiziitiin barreessi (hima 1-3). Haala: qormaata/qo'annoo eeri, gaaffii dhiibbaa malee deebisuu danda'u yoo xiqqaate tokko hammadhu, akkasumas qo'annoo waliin gochuuf yaada ykn filannoo dhiyeessi.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Karaa Hana filachuu danda'u lama yaadi (dhufee qo'achuu, mana keessatti qo'achuu).
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bocaa 'Do you want to ...?' ykn 'If you ..., we could ...' yaali.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ergaan Hana dhiibuu malee filachuuf bakka kennaa?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Deebii Hana irratti hundaa'uun haalli jijjiiramuu danda'u gaafatteettaa?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Dhugumaan odeeffannoo tarkaanfii 1 keessatti filatte gaafata ykn himaa?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Qormaata wal-fakkaataa ta'uu isaa gaafatee haala dabale.

x-e-h1-07.title: Karaan baaskilii haaraa dhugumaan balaa hir'ise?
x-e-h1-07.goal: Ragaan tokko tokkoon yeroo dabalamu, ibsi hammam amansiisaa akka ta'e irra deebi'ii madaali, akkasumas lakkoofsi kam rakkoo furu sababa waliin ibsi.
x-e-h1-07.material: Kun ibsa barruu magaalaa tokkoo dha. "The new bike lane made our street safer." Mallattoo tartiiba dubbisi.
x-e-h1-07.thinking.1: Bu'uura wal bira qabiinsa lakkoofsaa gaafachuu
x-e-h1-07.thinking.2: Ragaa tokkoon xumura irra hin ga'uu
x-e-h1-07.prereq.0: Barruu Afaan Ingiliizii gabaabaa sadarkaa kutaa jalqabaa mana barumsaa sadarkaa ol-aanaa dubbisuu
x-e-h1-07.prereq.1: Hubannoo guyyaa guyyaa 'sadarkaa' fi 'lakkoofsa' adda baasuuf gahaa
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.prompt: Mallattoo yeroo dubbistu hundatti, ibsi hammam akka deeggaramu murteessi.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Mallattoon haaraan lakkoofsa duraa ibsuu danda'u sababa kan biraa kennaa mirkaneessi.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Lakkoofsi 'dhimmoota meeqa' moo 'dhimmoota nama meeqaa irraa meeqa' ta'uu isaa adda baasi.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mallattoo kana qofaan, ibsi hammam deeggarama?
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.after: Ji'a wal-fakkaataa bara darbe irra xiqqaa kallattii ibsa waliin wal-fakkaata, garuu ji'a tokko qofa.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Mallattoon xiqqaa dha, lakkoofsa ji'a tokkoo irraa murteessuuf.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hamma tokko ni deeggarama, garuu ji'a tokko qofa dha, kanaaf dabalataan ilaaluu qabna.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Lakkoofsi kun ibsa waliin wal-qabatiinsa hin qabu.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Balaan xiqqaachuun odeeffannoo ibsa waliin wal-qabate dha.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mallattoo haaraa kana ilaalii ibsa ilaalchisee murtee kee jijjiiri.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Balaan karaa irraa moo roobni yeroo roobu namni baaskilii yaadu xiqqaa ta'uu irraa kan ka'e hir'ate beekuu hin dandeessu.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ibsi laafaa ta'e. Balaan namni baaskilii yaadu xiqqaachuu irraa kan ka'e hir'achuu danda'a.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Yoo namni baaskilii yaadu xiqqaate, balaan illee hir'achuu danda'a.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Amma ibsi sun soba ta'uun mirkanaa'eera.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Laafaa ta'e qofa; soba ta'uu isaa ragaa miti.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Hanga mallattoo dhumaatti dubbisii murtee kee cuunfi.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Yeroon dheerate, baay'inni namoota baaskilii yaadan ol ba'ullee, sadarkaan balaa gadi bu'e, kanaaf laafina jalqabaa furameera. Garuu sababni kan biraa gonkumaa hin jiru jechuu hin dandeessu.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wal bira qabiinsa yeroo waggaa tokkoo fi baay'ina namoota baaskilii yaadan ilaalcha keessa galche dabalameera.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Daataan kun sababni 'tokkicha' ta'uu isaa nutti hin himu.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.reflect: Mallattoo kam irratti amantaan kee baay'ee jijjiirame? Sababa isaa hima tokkoon himi.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.prompt: Maaliif 'balaan namoota baaskilii yaadan 1,000 tokkoon tokkoon isaaf' tarkaanfii 3 keessa jiru rakkoo tarkaanfii 2 furuuf caalaa gaarii dha?
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Baay'inni balaa tarkaanfii 2 keessatti maal rakkoo akka ture yaadadhu.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.hint.1: 'Namoota baaskilii yaadan 1,000 tokkoon tokkoon isaaf' maal irratti akka qoodamu mirkaneessi.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.a: Sababni isaa baay'ina balaa guddaa fakkeessa, kanaaf mul'ata
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.a: Lakkoofsi guddaa fakkaachuu fi wal bira qabiinsi haqa qabeessa ta'uun garaagara.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.b: Madaallii lakkaa'uu jijjiirame; balaan baay'ee lakkaa'ama jechuu miti.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.c: Sababni isaa baay'inni namoota baaskilii yaadan yoo jijjiirames haqa qabeessa ta'ee wal bira qabuu dandeessa
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.explain: Yoo baay'ina qofa wal bira qabde, yeroo namoonni xiqqaatan baaskilii yaadan karaa irraa kan ka'e balaan hir'ate beekuu hin dandeessu. Yoo gara balaa namoota 1,000 tokkoon tokkoon isaaf jijjiirte, dhiibbaa baay'ina namootaa hir'isuun wal bira qabuu dandeessa.

x-e-h1-08.title: Madda lamaan dhugumaan wal-hin-simuu?
x-e-h1-08.goal: Cuunfaa madda lamaanii keessatti sarara dogoggora argadhii sirreessi, akkasumas tarkaanfii itti aanu wal-faallessuu furuuf filadhu.
x-e-h1-08.material:
Kun madda lama fi cuunfaa barataa dha (lakkoofsi sararaa cuunfaa 1 irraa jalqaba).

Madda A (oduu magaalaa, Fuulbana 3): "The Hanbit Library reopened on March 1 after repairs. It now opens seven days a week, and about 300 people visited on the first day."
Madda B (blogii mana kitaabaa, Fuulbana 5): "We reopened on March 2. We are open six days a week, closed on Mondays. More than 300 visitors came on our first day!"
x-e-h1-08.thinking.0: Wal-faallessuu dhugaa fi kan fakkaatu adda baasuu
x-e-h1-08.thinking.1: Dogoggora cuunfaa keessa jiru argachuu fi sirreessuu
x-e-h1-08.prereq.0: Oduu fi barreeffama blogii Afaan Ingiliizii gabaabaa sadarkaa kutaa jalqabaa mana barumsaa sadarkaa ol-aanaa dubbisuu
x-e-h1-08.prereq.1: Hubannoo lakkoofsaa guyyaa guyyaa 'about 300' fi 'more than 300' wal-simuu isaa murteessuuf gahaa
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarara dogoggora cuunfaa barataa keessa jiru tokko filadhu. (Sararri dogoggora lama ykn isaa ol yoo ta'an illee tokko qofa filachuun gahaa dha.)
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.hint.0: Sarara tokkoon tokkoon isaaf, lakkoofsa ykn guyyaa madda lamaanii cinaa cinaan barreessi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.hint.1: Lakkoofsonni lamaan yeroo tokkotti dhugaa ta'uu danda'uu isaanii tokko tokkoon qori.
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.explain: Sararri 3 fi 5 rakkoo dha. 'about 300' fi 'more than 300' lamaanuu dhugaa ta'uu danda'u, kanaaf baay'inni daawwattootaa wal-faallessuu miti (sarara 3). Sararri 5 madda tokko dogoggora jedha, garuu barreeffama kana qofaan isa kam dogoggora akka ta'e beekuu hin dandeessu. Wal-faallessuun sarara 2 fi 4 dhugaa dha.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.prompt: Sararri cuunfaa baay'ina daawwattoota madda lamaanii wal bira qabu dogoggora jedhii yaadi, sarara sana sirreessii hima Afaan Ingiliizii tokko ykn lamaan barreessi. Baay'inni daawwattoota madda lamaanii akkamitti wal-qabatu hammadhu.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.hint.0: Madda lamaan tokkoon tokkoon isaa baay'ina daawwattootaa akkamitti akka ibsu sirriitti garagalchii barreessi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.hint.1: "about" fi "more than" tokkoon tokkoon isaa daangaa lakkoofsaa kam akka ibsan barreessi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: 'About 300' fi 'more than 300' walitti dhugaa ta'uu danda'uun ni mul'ataa?
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Maqaa madda lamaanii (Madda A/B) ykn ibsa isaanii sirriitti barreessiteettaa?
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.modelNote.2: Lakkoofsa addaa (310) fayyadamuun lamaanuu dhugaa ta'uu akka danda'an agarsiise.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.prompt: Guyyaan banamu Fuulbana 1 moo 2 ta'uu isaa ifa gochuuf tarkaanfiin itti aanu isa gaarii kami?
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.hint.0: Barreeffama lamaan odeeffannoo kam irratti hundaa'uu akka danda'an yaadi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.hint.1: Gama tokkoon osoo hin amanin dura madda sadaffaa mirkaneessuu dandeessu tokko yaadi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.o.a: Madda B guyyaa booda barreeffame, kanaaf adda mirkaneessuu malee B hordofi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.r.a: Barreeffamni booda barreeffamuun isaa qofa guyyaan sirrii ta'uu hin agarsiisu. Ragaa guyyaa kallattiin mirkaneesse barbaachisa.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.o.b: Galmee guyyaa banamuu irratti hojjetame (akka beeksisa) argadhii mirkaneessi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.r.c: Baay'inni namoota dubbisanii sirrii ta'uu hin mirkaneessu.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.explain: Maaliif guyyaan garaagara akka ta'e beekuuf, ragaa kallattii akka galmee guyyaa sanatti hojjetame barbaachisa. Yeroo barreeffamuu ykn baay'ina dubbistootaa qofaan gama kam sirrii akka ta'e beekuun hin danda'amu.

x-e-h1-10.title: Haasaa afeerraa didu hariiroo eegu hojjechuu
x-e-h1-10.topic: Deebii ykn haasaa haala guutu barreessuu
x-e-h1-10.goal: Haasaa Afaan Ingiliizii gabaabaa haalawwan hunda guutu (diddaa ifa, sababa, filannoo, fi hubannoo nama kaanii) of-keetii barreessi.
x-e-h1-10.material: Hiriyaan A B'f Sanbata sa'aatii 7 p.m. kon-saartii waliin deemuuf afeera. B galgala sana taatee maatii qaba, deemuu hin dandeessu.
x-e-h1-10.prereq.0: Haasaa Afaan Ingiliizii gabaabaa sadarkaa kutaa jalqabaa mana barumsaa sadarkaa ol-aanaa dubbisuu fi barreessuu
x-e-h1-10.prereq.1: Ibsa bu'uuraa yeroo afeerraa fudhachuu hin dandeenye itti fayyadaman
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.prompt: B'f mallattoo diduuf isa mijaa'aan isa kami?
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Deebii tokkoon tokkoon isaa erga dhaga'ee booda A 'B deemuu danda'a moo hin danda'u' beekuu danda'uu isaa mirkaneessi.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Dhiibbaa miira A irratti qabu wal bira qabi.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.r.a: Ifa dha, garuu toonii afeerraa nama kaanii xiqqeessa.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.r.c: "I'll try" diduu moo fudhachuu ta'uu isaa irratti hin ifa, kanaaf nama kaan karoora baasuun ulfaataa dha.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.explain: Yeroo diduun ifaan (can't), sababni, fi filannoon (guyyaa biraa) walitti jiraatan, nama kaan hin dogoggorsu, kan miidhamu illee xiqqaata. Deebiin hin ifa nama kaan eeggachiisa, jecha baay'ee jabaan immoo hariiroo cimsa.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.prompt:
Haasaa A fi B giddu Afaan Ingiliiziitiin hojjedhu. Sarara tokkoon tokkoon isaa A: ykn B: jedhuun jalqabi, yoo xiqqaate sarara 4 barreessi.
Haala 1) B ifatti deemuu hin dandeenye jedha (can't, kkf).
Haala 2) B sababa kenna.
Haala 3) B guyyaa biraa ykn karaa biraa dhiyeessa.
Haala 4) A deebii hubannoo agarsiisu agarsiisa.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.0: Duraan sababa (tapha maatii, kkf) fi filannoo (guyyaa biraa) murteessi, ergasii tartiiba sararaa karoorsi.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Tartiiba deebii jalqabaa B keessatti barreessi: 'thanks' galchi, ergasii can't fayyadami.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Diduun B 'ifa' dhaa, moo 'try to come' akka ta'e hin ifa dhaa?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Filannoon sun dhugumaan raawwatamuu danda'u dhiyaatee jira (guyyaan ykn karaan jira)?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.modelNote.2: Jechoota adda ta'anis haalawwan wal-fakkaataa guute.
